t: A brick-building robot kit that a BBC micro:bit brings to life.
steps: Buy a Nezha Pro kit from the ELECFREAKS shop. Pick a bundle with a micro:bit. Base kits leave it out.
Charge the box over USB-C until all four lights glow, then unplug it.
Build the first guided model from the ELECFREAKS wiki.
Press the box buttons to spin the motors with no code.
Open the free Microsoft MakeCode editor for micro:bit in a web browser.
Add the nezha2 extension from the Extensions menu.
Try the sample program that moves a motor to a set angle.
Download the program to the micro:bit and plug it into the box.
